_note: USD per 1M input and output tokens. The Venice price is copied from the motion experiment's pricing.json (Venice's /models model_spec, 2026-11-21); the Gemini price is that file's estimate. image_tokens_per_mpx, image_tokens, chars_per_token and expected_output feed the dry run and budget gate, and were measured on this experiment's first video: Qwen3-VL bills 32 px patches (about 977 tokens per megapixel, 4096 for a 2048 px square sheet), Gemini bills about 1100 tokens an image at its default media resolution whatever the size, and both count subtitle text at about 2.8 characters a token.
